online.desc: Is the browser connected to a network? 'false' is reliable (the browser knows it is offline); 'true' only means that a network is present, not that the Internet is reachable

hasConnectionInfo.desc: Does the browser expose the Network Information API (navigator.connection)? When 'false', all the connection props stay 'undefined'

effectiveType.desc: Effective connection type, as estimated by the browser from the measured round-trip time and downlink speed; 'undefined' when the browser does not expose it

downlink.desc: Effective bandwidth estimate (in megabits per second), rounded by the browser; 'undefined' when the browser does not expose it

rtt.desc: Effective round-trip time estimate (in milliseconds), rounded by the browser; 'undefined' when the browser does not expose it

saveData.desc: Has the user asked for reduced data usage (the browser's Data Saver / Lite mode)? 'undefined' when the browser does not expose it
